why: Both share the same strong jute rug, round wood table and paper lantern, but B's oatmeal-beige sofa is the warm beige the client asked for and ties better with the jute and walnut than A's cooler gray-white sofa. Its tall braided money tree also reads as a larger plant by the balcony door. Neither proposal gives a truly low sofa or the requested ceramic pot, since both plants come in plastic nursery pots.
